messages:
lina: Heads-up — noticed a telemetry gap during the EU burst this morning. queue depth spiked but autoscaler didn't trigger. Grafana panel shows a hole between ~09:12–09:16 UTC.

pj: which cluster/region?

lina: eu-west-1, pool=gpu-v100, shard=rdw-frontend. Saw the spike on `queue_depth_per_pool` but series disappears for ~4m.

vera: @lina can you paste the PromQL for that panel?

lina: Sure — current panel uses:
```
sum by(pool)(increase(requests_queued_total[1m]))
```
But our metric exporter was changed yesterday and renamed `pool` -> `capacity_pool` for a subset of nodes. Also noticed scrape interval for those targets went from 30s -> 60s. Suspect label mismatch + scrape change created the hole.

mohit: Autoscaler logs corroborate. No scale events during the spike — headroom calc read queue_depth=0 repeatedly. Sample log: 
```
2026-03-18T09:13:02Z INFO headroom calc: pool=, queue_depth=0, desired=0
```
So the headroom service saw no queued requests because the metric series vanished.

autoscaler-bot: [09:13:30] no-scaling-event for pool gpu-v100 (capacity=40) — reason: insufficient_headroom

pj: Proposal: quick fixes — (A) make dashboard PromQL robust to rename (accept both labels), (B) change alert rule to reference both metric shapes and extend evaluation window to 2m, (C) revert scrape interval change for problematic exporter group.

vera: +1. Also suggest adding a metric-name alias or a recording rule to normalize `requests_queued_total` by labels so dashboards/alerts don't break on rename. Backfilling continuity in Grafana can be done by using the recording rule for historical continuity.

lina: Plan I'll run in the next 10m: 1) Update dashboard PromQL to `sum by(capacity_pool)(increase(requests_queued_total[1m])) or sum(increase(requests_queued_total[1m]))` as a temporary fallback. 2) Add recording rule `rdw:queued:sum` to capture normalized series. 3) Update alert `HighQueueDepthNoScale` to check `rdw:queued:sum` and extend for 2m evaluation. 4) Revert scrape interval for exporter nodes and annotate metrics-changelog.

pj: Good. Add a short runbook step: if dashboard shows sudden series drop, check `metrics-changelog` and `prometheus/targets` for label drift. Also add an automated lint in exporter PRs to flag label renames.

lina: Will open a quick RFC and push the dashboard patch now. I'll ping @oncall if anything repeats.

mohit: Thx — once the recording rule exists I can re-run headroom recalcs locally to verify autoscaler sees the same numbers.

lina: Thanks team — deploying dashboard + recording rule in ~10m.
